metadata.title: docs: add Test Gateway Connectivity explanation and SSE testing guide
metadata.author: Yashrajsingh2001

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
- Closes #4040

---

## 📝 Summary
Adds comprehensive documentation for the "Test Gateway Connectivity" feature in the Admin UI to clarify its purpose and scope. The documentation explains that this feature performs a basic HTTP reachability check (not a full MCP protocol test) and provides step-by-step guidance for testing SSE servers end-to-end with session IDs.

**Changes:**
- Added new "Testing Gateway Connectivity" section in ui-concepts.md explaining what the feature does and doesn't do
- Included practical examples for SSE session testing with curl commands
- Added comparison table of different test methods (connectivity check vs SSE stream vs tool test button)
- Added cross-reference in acceptance.md testing documentation
